blocks.content: NITI Aayog acts as the premier policy Think Tank of the Government of India, providing both directional and policy inputs.

rows: Power to allocate funds to states and ministries
Limited role through National Development Council

items: NITI Aayog is an extra-constitutional, non-statutory body established via an executive resolution.
The Prime Minister of India serves as the Ex-Officio Chairperson of NITI Aayog.
Frequently tested distinction: NITI Aayog has no power to allocate funds to states, unlike the erstwhile Planning Commission.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: NITI Aayog functions as the premier policy think tank of the Government of India, providing both directional and policy inputs.
It fosters Cooperative Federalism through structured, continuous support initiatives with states.
It operates via two primary hubs: the Team India Hub and the Knowledge and Innovation Hub.
Unlike the former Planning Commission, NITI Aayog does not allocate funds, leaving fund allocation to the Ministry of Finance.
It adopts a bottom-up approach to policy planning, ensuring local-level needs are represented at the national level.
